description: Wire mcp_traffic_fingerprints library into mcp_scanner daemon for MCP protocol confirmation when scanning candidate server responses. Import detect_mcp_methods, is_mcp_traffic, extract_session_indicators from mcp_traffic_fingerprints. When scanning a server endpoint, call is_mcp_traffic() on response body to confirm MCP protocol presence. Add fingerprint evidence to mcp_fingerprints table via write_service. No HTTP between peer daemons. Follow write_service contract on :8772.
